1.english_reference: they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people

traditions.KJV: they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people ;

1.english_reference: that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever

traditions.VUL: quod non débeant introíre Ammonítes et Moabítes in ecclésiam Dei usque in ætérnum :
traditions.KJV: that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever ;

2.english_reference: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water

traditions.VUL: eo quod non occúrrerint fíliis Israel cum pane et aqua :
traditions.KJV: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water ,

2.english_reference: but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר עָלָ֤י ו אֶת בִּלְעָם֙ לְ קַֽלְל֔ וֹ

traditions.KJV: but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them :

2.english_reference: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ אֱלֹהֵ֛י נוּ הַ קְּלָלָ֖ה לִ בְרָכָֽה

traditions.KJV: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .

traditions.VUL: Factum est autem ,

traditions.LXX: ὡς ἤκουσαν τὸν νόμον ,
traditions.VUL: cum audíssent legem ,
traditions.KJV: when they had heard the law ,

traditions.VUL: separavérunt omnem alienígenam ab Israel .
traditions.KJV: that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude .

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ פְנֵ֣י מִ זֶּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ πρὸ τούτου
traditions.VUL: Et super hoc
traditions.KJV: And before this ,

4.english_reference: Eliashib the priest , having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God

traditions.WLC: אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַ כֹּהֵ֔ן נָת֖וּן בְּ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֑י נוּ

traditions.LXX: ἐγγίων Τωβιά .
traditions.VUL: et próximus Tobíæ .
traditions.KJV: allied unto Tobiah :

5.english_reference: And he had prepared for him a great chamber

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ γαζοφυλάκιον μέγα ,
traditions.VUL: Fecit ergo sibi gazophylácium grande ,
traditions.KJV: And he had prepared for him a great chamber ,

5.english_reference: where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁ֣ם הָי֪וּ לְ פָנִ֟ים נֹ֠תְנִים אֶת הַ מִּנְחָ֨ה הַ לְּבוֹנָ֜ה וְ הַ כֵּלִ֗ים וּ מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַ דָּגָן֙ הַ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ הַ יִּצְהָ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἦσαν τὸ πρότερον διδόντες τὴν μαναὰμ καὶ τὸν λίβανον καὶ τὰ σκεύη , καὶ τὴν δεκάτην τοῦ σίτου καὶ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου ,

traditions.WLC: מִצְוַת֙ הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ הַ מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְ הַ שֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: which was commanded [ to be given ] to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters ;

traditions.WLC: וּ תְרוּמַ֖ת הַ כֹּהֲנִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπαρχαὶ τῶν ἱερέων .
traditions.VUL: et primítias sacerdotáles .
traditions.KJV: and the offerings of the priests .

6.english_reference: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל זֶ֕ה לֹ֥א הָיִ֖יתִי בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν παντὶ τούτῳ οὐκ ἤμην ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: In ómnibus autem his non fui in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: But in all this [ time ] was not I at Jerusalem :

6.english_reference: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon

traditions.WLC: כִּ֡י בִּ שְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּ שְׁתַּ֜יִם לְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν ἔτει τριακοστῷ καὶ δευτέρῳ τοῦ Ἀρσασαθὰ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

traditions.KJV: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon

traditions.LXX: ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ,
traditions.VUL: veni ad regem ,
traditions.KJV: came I unto the king ,

6.english_reference: and after certain days obtained I leave of the king

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ קֵ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים נִשְׁאַ֥לְתִּי מִן הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετὰ τέλος ἡμερῶν ᾐτησάμην τὸν βασιλέα ,

traditions.KJV: and after certain days obtained I leave of the king :

traditions.WLC: וָ אָב֖וֹא לִֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: Et veni in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: And I came to Jerusalem ,

7.english_reference: and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah

traditions.WLC: וָ אָבִ֣ינָ ה בָ רָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ לְ ט֣וֹבִיָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνῆκα ἐν πονηρίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: et intelléxi malum , quod fécerat Elíasib Tobíæ ,
traditions.KJV: and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah ,

7.english_reference: in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת ל וֹ֙ נִשְׁכָּ֔ה בְּ חַצְרֵ֖י בֵּ֥ית הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: ποιῆσαι αὐτῷ γαζοφυλάκιον ἐν αὐλῇ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ .

traditions.KJV: in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God .

traditions.VUL: præcepíque ,
traditions.KJV: Then I commanded ,

traditions.VUL: et emundavérunt gazophylácia :
traditions.KJV: and they cleansed the chambers :

traditions.VUL: et rétuli ibi vasa domus Dei , sacrifícium , et thus .
traditions.KJV: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God , with the meat offering and the frankincense .

traditions.WLC: וָ אָרִ֨יבָ ה֙ אֶת הַ סְּגָנִ֔ים

traditions.VUL: et egi causam advérsus magistrátus ,
traditions.KJV: Then contended I with the rulers ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹ֣מְרָ֔ ה מַדּ֖וּעַ נֶעֱזַ֣ב בֵּית הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: and said , Why is the house of God forsaken ?

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אֶ֨קְבְּצֵ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγον αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Et congregávi eos ,
traditions.KJV: And I gathered them together ,

11.english_reference: and set them in their place .

traditions.KJV: and set them in their place .

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל יְהוּדָ֗ה הֵבִ֜יאוּ מַעְשַׂ֧ר הַ דָּגָ֛ן וְ הַ תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְ הַ יִּצְהָ֖ר לָ אוֹצָרֽוֹת

traditions.VUL: Et constitúimus super hórrea
traditions.KJV: And I made treasurers over the treasuries ,

traditions.LXX: Σελεμιὰ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ Σαδδοὺκ τοῦ γραμματέως καὶ Φαδαιὰ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευειτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Selemíam sacerdótem , et Sadoc scribam , et Phadaíam de Levítis ,
traditions.KJV: Shelemiah the priest , and Zadok the scribe , and of the Levites , Pedaiah :

13.english_reference: and next to them [ was ] Hanan the son of Zaccur , the son of Mattaniah :

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל יָדָ֔ ם חָנָ֥ן בֶּן זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן מַתַּנְיָ֑ה

traditions.KJV: and next to them [ was ] Hanan the son of Zaccur , the son of Mattaniah :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י נֶאֱמָנִים֙ נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πιστοὶ ἐλογίσθησαν
traditions.VUL: quóniam fidéles comprobáti sunt ,

traditions.VUL: et ipsis créditæ sunt partes fratrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: and their office [ was ] to distribute unto their brethren .

14.english_reference: Remember me , O my God , concerning this ,

traditions.VUL: Meménto mei Deus meus pro hoc ,
traditions.KJV: Remember me , O my God , concerning this ,

traditions.KJV: and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .

traditions.KJV: which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day :

15.english_reference: and I testified [ against them ] in the day wherein they sold victuals .

traditions.WLC: וָ אָעִ֕יד בְּ י֖וֹם מִכְרָ֥ ם צָֽיִד

traditions.VUL: Et contestátus sum , ut in die qua véndere licéret , vénderent .
traditions.KJV: and I testified [ against them ] in the day wherein they sold victuals .

16.english_reference: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν αὐτῇ
traditions.VUL: Et Týrii habitavérunt in ea ,
traditions.KJV: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein ,

traditions.VUL: inferéntes pisces , et ómnia venália :
traditions.KJV: which brought fish , and all manner of ware ,

16.english_reference: and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וּ מֹכְרִ֧ים בַּ שַּׁבָּ֛ת לִ בְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ בִ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם

traditions.KJV: and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .

17.english_reference: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אָרִ֕יבָ ה אֵ֖ת חֹרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה

traditions.VUL: Et obiurgávi optimátes Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah ,

17.english_reference: and said unto them , What evil thing [ is ] this that ye do ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמְרָ֣ ה לָ הֶ֗ם מָֽה הַ דָּבָ֨ר הָ רָ֤ע הַ זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים

traditions.VUL: et dixi eis : Quæ est hæc res mala , quam vos fácitis ,
traditions.KJV: and said unto them , What evil thing [ is ] this that ye do ,

traditions.WLC: וּֽ מְחַלְּלִ֖ים אֶת י֥וֹם הַ שַּׁבָּֽת
traditions.LXX: καὶ βεβηλοῦτε τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ σαββάτου ;
traditions.VUL: et profanátis diem sábbati ?
traditions.KJV: and profane the sabbath day ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֨וֹא כֹ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ אֲבֹ֣תֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: οὐχὶ οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Numquid non hæc fecérunt patres nostri ,
traditions.KJV: Did not your fathers thus ,

18.english_reference: and did not our God bring all this evil upon us , and upon this city ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֵ֨א אֱלֹהֵ֜י נוּ עָלֵ֗י נוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ רָעָ֣ה הַ זֹּ֔את וְ עַ֖ל הָ עִ֣יר הַ זֹּ֑את
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤνεγκεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην ;

traditions.KJV: and did not our God bring all this evil upon us , and upon this city ?

18.english_reference: yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath .

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֞ם מוֹסִיפִ֤ים חָרוֹן֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת הַ שַּׁבָּֽת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς προστίθετε ὀργὴν ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ , βεβηλῶσαι τὸ σάββατον ;
traditions.VUL: et vos ádditis iracúndiam super Israel violándo sábbatum .
traditions.KJV: yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath .

19.english_reference: And it came to pass , that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֡י כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽלֲלוּ֩ שַׁעֲרֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ שַּׁבָּ֗ת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα κατέστησαν πύλαι Ἰερουσαλὴμ πρὸ τοῦ σαββάτου ,
traditions.VUL: Factum est autem , cum quievíssent portæ Ierúsalem in die sábbati ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath ,

19.english_reference: I commanded that the gates should be shut ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹֽמְרָ ה֙ וַ יִּסָּגְר֣וּ הַ דְּלָת֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔκλεισα τὰς πύλας ,
traditions.VUL: dixi : et clausérunt iánuas ,
traditions.KJV: I commanded that the gates should be shut ,

19.english_reference: and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath :

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹ֣מְרָ֔ ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִפְתָּח֔וּ ם עַ֖ד אַחַ֣ר הַ שַּׁבָּ֑ת
traditions.LXX: εἶπα ὥστε μὴ ἀνοιγῆναι αὐτὰς ὀπίσω τοῦ σαββάτου ·
traditions.VUL: et præcépi ut non aperírent eas usque post sábbatum :
traditions.KJV: and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath :

19.english_reference: and [ some ] of my servants set I at the gates ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ נְּעָרַ֗ י הֶֽעֱמַ֨דְתִּי֙ עַל הַ שְּׁעָרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησα ἐπὶ τὰς πύλας ,
traditions.VUL: et de púeris meis constítui super portas ,
traditions.KJV: and [ some ] of my servants set I at the gates , [ that ]

19.english_reference: [ that ] there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day .

traditions.WLC: לֹא יָב֥וֹא מַשָּׂ֖א בְּ י֥וֹם הַ שַּׁבָּֽת
traditions.LXX: ὥστε μὴ αἴρειν βαστάγματα ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου .
traditions.VUL: ut nullus inférret onus in die sábbati .
traditions.KJV: there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day .

20.english_reference: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּלִ֨ינוּ הָ רֹכְלִ֜ים וּ מֹכְרֵ֧י כָל מִמְכָּ֛ר מִ ח֥וּץ לִ ירוּשָׁלִָ֖ם פַּ֥עַם וּ שְׁתָּֽיִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ηὐλίσθησαν πάντες καὶ ἐποίησαν πρᾶσιν ἔξω Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς .
traditions.VUL: Et mansérunt negotiatóres , et vendéntes univérsa venália , foris Ierúsalem semel et bis .
traditions.KJV: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .

21.english_reference: Then I testified against them , and said unto them ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אָעִ֣ידָ ה בָ הֶ֗ם וָ אֹמְרָ֤ ה אֲלֵי הֶם֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπεμαρτυράμην ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς
traditions.VUL: Et contestátus sum eos , et dixi eis :
traditions.KJV: Then I testified against them , and said unto them ,

21.english_reference: Why lodge ye about the wall ?

traditions.WLC: מַדּ֜וּעַ אַתֶּ֤ם לֵנִים֙ נֶ֣גֶד הַ חוֹמָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Διὰ τί ὑμεῖς αὐλίζεσθε ἀπέναντι τοῦ τείχους ;
traditions.VUL: Quare manétis ex advérso muri ?
traditions.KJV: Why lodge ye about the wall ?

21.english_reference: if ye do [ so ] again , I will lay hands on you .

traditions.WLC: אִם תִּשְׁנ֕וּ יָ֖ד אֶשְׁלַ֣ח בָּ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν δευτερώσητε , ἐκτενῶ χεῖρά μου ἐν ὑμῖν .
traditions.VUL: si secúndo hoc fecéritis , manum mittam in vos .
traditions.KJV: if ye do [ so ] again , I will lay hands on you .

21.english_reference: From that time forth came they no [ more ] on the sabbath .

traditions.WLC: מִן הָ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֔יא לֹא בָ֖אוּ בַּ שַּׁבָּֽת
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τοῦ καιροῦ ἐκείνου οὐκ ἤλθοσαν ἐν σαββάτῳ .
traditions.VUL: Itaque ex témpore illo non venérunt in sábbato .
traditions.KJV: From that time forth came they no [ more ] on the sabbath .

22.english_reference: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמְרָ֣ ה לַ לְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְי֤וּ מִֽטַּהֲרִים֙

traditions.VUL: Dixi quoque Levítis ut mundaréntur ,
traditions.KJV: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָאִים֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים הַ שְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְ קַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ שַּׁבָּ֑ת

traditions.KJV: and [ that ] they should come [ and ] keep the gates , to sanctify the sabbath day .

22.english_reference: Remember me , O my God , [ concerning ] this also , and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy .

traditions.KJV: Remember me , O my God , [ concerning ] this also , and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵינָ֥ ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְ דַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית

traditions.KJV: and could not speak in the Jews ’ language ,

traditions.KJV: but according to the language of each people .

25.english_reference: And I contended with them , and cursed them ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אָרִ֤יב עִמָּ ם֙ וָ אֲקַֽלְלֵ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην μετ᾽ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκαταρασάμην αὐτούς ·
traditions.VUL: Et obiurgávi eos , et maledíxi .
traditions.KJV: And I contended with them , and cursed them ,

25.english_reference: and smote certain of them , and plucked off their hair ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אַכֶּ֥ה מֵ הֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וָֽ אֶמְרְטֵ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄνδρας

25.english_reference: and made them swear by God , [ saying ] ,

traditions.VUL: et adiurávi in Deo ,
traditions.KJV: and made them swear by God , [ saying ] ,

traditions.KJV: Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons ,

25.english_reference: nor take their daughters unto your sons , or for yourselves .

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם תִּשְׂאוּ֙ מִ בְּנֹ֣תֵי הֶ֔ם לִ בְנֵי כֶ֖ם וְ לָ כֶֽם

traditions.VUL: et non accíperent de filiábus eórum fíliis suis , et sibimetípsis , dicens :
traditions.KJV: nor take their daughters unto your sons , or for yourselves .

26.english_reference: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ?

traditions.KJV: who was beloved of his God ,

traditions.VUL: et ipsum ergo duxérunt ad peccátum mulíeres alienígenæ .
traditions.KJV: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin .

27.english_reference: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לָ כֶ֣ם הֲ נִשְׁמַ֗ע לַ עֲשֹׂת֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הָ רָעָ֤ה הַ גְּדוֹלָה֙ הַ זֹּ֔את

traditions.WLC: לִ מְעֹ֖ל בֵּֽ אלֹהֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀσυνθετῆσαι ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: ut prævaricémur in Deo nostro ,
traditions.KJV: to transgress against our God

traditions.WLC: לְ הֹשִׁ֖יב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καθίσαι γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας .
traditions.VUL: et ducámus uxóres peregrínas ?

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰωαδὰ τοῦ Ἐλεισοὺβ τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ μεγάλου νυμφίου τοῦ Σαναβαλλάτ ·
traditions.VUL: De fíliis autem Ióiada fílii Elíasib sacerdótis magni , gener erat Sanabállat Horonítes ,
